description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Kami of Whispered Hopes's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.
